---
title: "Presenting: Checklist"
description: "A submission checklist for the Presenting Music component."
categories: [Reference, Assessment, Presenting]
toc: true
toc-depth: 2
---

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
*See also: [Assessment Rubrics → Presenting](../resources/rubrics.html#presenting-music)*
:::

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  var PERF_KEY   = 'pieces:presenting:performing';
  var CREA_KEY   = 'pieces:presenting:creating';
  var NPERF_KEY  = 'presenting:nPerf';
  var NCREA_KEY  = 'presenting:nCrea';
  var CB_KEY     = 'checklist:presenting';
  var PERF_SLOTS = 5;
  var CREA_SLOTS = 3;
  var PERF_MIN   = 3; var PERF_MAX = 5;
  var CREA_MIN   = 1; var CREA_MAX = 3;
  var nPerf = Math.min(PERF_MAX, Math.max(PERF_MIN, parseInt(localStorage.getItem(NPERF_KEY))||4));
  var nCrea = Math.min(CREA_MAX, Math.max(CREA_MIN, parseInt(localStorage.getItem(NCREA_KEY))||2));

  // ── Upload timing / word-count helpers ────────────────────────────────────────
  var TH2 = 'text-align:left;font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#999;padding:.3rem .3rem;border-bottom:1px solid #e0d6c8;font-weight:400;white-space:nowrap;';
  var TD2 = 'padding:.25rem .3rem;vertical-align:middle;';
  var INP2 = 'font-size:.82rem;padding:.2rem .3rem;border:1px solid #c8bfaf;border-radius:2px;background:#faf8f5;color:#2c2416;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;';
  var JUMP_BTN = 'background:none;border:none;padding:0;color:#5b9bd5;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline dotted;font-family:inherit;';

  function fmtTime(s) { var m=Math.floor(s/60),r=s%60; return m+':'+(r<10?'0':'')+r; }

  function timeBar(secs, maxSecs) {
    var over = secs > maxSecs;
    var pct = maxSecs ? Math.min(secs/maxSecs*100,100).toFixed(1) : 0;
    var ratio = maxSecs ? Math.min(secs/maxSecs,1) : 0;
    var barColor, timeColor;
    if (over) { barColor='#c0392b'; timeColor='#c0392b'; }
    else { var hue=Math.round(120+ratio*3),sat=Math.round(36+ratio*10),lit=Math.round(75-ratio*41); barColor='hsl('+hue+','+sat+'%,'+lit+'%)'; timeColor='#444'; }
    return '<div style="margin:.3rem 0 .7rem;">'
      +'<div style="background:#e8e4df;border-radius:3px;height:5px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:.3rem;">'
      +'<div style="background:'+barColor+';width:'+pct+'%;height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .3s;"></div></div>'
      +'<span style="color:'+timeColor+';font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;">'+fmtTime(secs)+'</span>'
      +'<span style="color:#aaa;font-size:.82rem;"> / '+fmtTime(maxSecs)+' max</span>'
      +(over?'<span style="color:#c0392b;font-size:.75rem;margin-left:.5rem;">&#9888; over limit</span>':'')
      +'</div>';
  }

  function wordBar(words, maxWords) {
    var over = words > maxWords;
    var pct = maxWords ? Math.min(words/maxWords*100,100).toFixed(1) : 0;
    var ratio = maxWords ? Math.min(words/maxWords,1) : 0;
    var barColor, wordColor;
    if (over) { barColor='#c0392b'; wordColor='#c0392b'; }
    else { var hue=Math.round(120+ratio*3),sat=Math.round(36+ratio*10),lit=Math.round(75-ratio*41); barColor='hsl('+hue+','+sat+'%,'+lit+'%)'; wordColor='#444'; }
    return '<div style="margin:.3rem 0 .7rem;">'
      +'<div style="background:#e8e4df;border-radius:3px;height:5px;overflow:hidden;margin-bottom:.3rem;">'
      +'<div style="background:'+barColor+';width:'+pct+'%;height:100%;border-radius:3px;transition:width .3s;"></div></div>'
      +'<span style="color:'+wordColor+';font-size:.82rem;font-weight:600;">'+words+' words</span>'
      +'<span style="color:#aaa;font-size:.82rem;"> / '+maxWords+' max</span>'
      +(over?'<span style="color:#c0392b;font-size:.75rem;margin-left:.5rem;">&#9888; over limit</span>':'')
      +'</div>';
  }

  function inlineOverWarning(secs, maxSecs) {
    return secs > maxSecs ? '<span style="color:#c0392b;font-size:.72rem;margin-left:.4rem;">&#9888; over '+fmtTime(maxSecs)+'</span>' : '';
  }
  var AOI_OPTS = ['', '1', '2', '3', '4'];
  var CREA_METHOD_OPTS = ['', 'Staff Notation', 'DAW', 'Alternative notation', 'Improvisation'];
  var INP = 'font-size:.82rem;padding:.2rem .3rem;border:1px solid #c8bfaf;border-radius:2px;background:#faf8f5;color:#2c2416;width:100%;box-sizing:border-box;';
  var SEL = INP + 'cursor:pointer;';
  var TH  = 'text-align:left;font-size:.7rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#999;padding:.3rem .3rem;border-bottom:1px solid #e0d6c8;font-weight:400;white-space:nowrap;';
  var TD  = 'padding:.25rem .2rem;';
  var BTN = 'font-size:.78rem;padding:.2rem .5rem;border:1px solid #c8bfaf;border-radius:3px;background:transparent;color:#666;cursor:pointer;margin-right:.3rem;';

  function esc(s) { return (s||'').replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;'); }

  // ── Piece display helpers ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  function presCreaPieceText(idx) {
    var p = creaPieces && creaPieces[idx];
    var name = p && p.name;
    return name ? esc(name) : '<em style="color:#bbb;font-style:italic;font-size:.8rem;">Creating piece '+(idx+1)+'</em>';
  }
  function presPerfPieceText(idx) {
    var p = perfPieces && perfPieces[idx];
    var name = p && p.name;
    return name ? esc(name) : '<em style="color:#bbb;font-style:italic;font-size:.8rem;">Performing piece '+(idx+1)+'</em>';
  }

  window.presJumpCrea = function(idx) {
    var tracker = document.getElementById('pres-crea-tracker');
    if (!tracker) return;
    var rows = tracker.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
    var target = rows[idx];
    if (!target || target.style.display === 'none') return;
    target.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'center' });
    target.classList.remove('piece-row-highlight');
    void target.offsetWidth;
    target.classList.add('piece-row-highlight');
    setTimeout(function(){ target.classList.remove('piece-row-highlight'); }, 2500);
  };

  window.presJumpPerf = function(idx) {
    var tracker = document.getElementById('pres-perf-tracker');
    if (!tracker) return;
    var rows = tracker.querySelectorAll('tbody tr');
    var target = rows[idx];
    if (!target || target.style.display === 'none') return;
    target.scrollIntoView({ behavior:'smooth', block:'center' });
    target.classList.remove('piece-row-highlight');
    void target.offsetWidth;
    target.classList.add('piece-row-highlight');
    setTimeout(function(){ target.classList.remove('piece-row-highlight'); }, 2500);
  };

  function perfBlank() { return {name:'',composer:'',genre:'',aoi:'',lenMin:'',lenSec:'',ensemble:false,excerptRequired:false,excerptMin:'',excerptSec:''}; }
  function creaBlank() { return {name:'',method:'',genre:'',aoi:'',lenMin:'',lenSec:''}; }

  function loadPieces(key, slots, blankFn) {
    try { var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key))||[]; while(d.length<slots)d.push(blankFn()); return d.slice(0,slots); }
    catch(e) { return Array(slots).fill(null).map(blankFn); }
  }
  var perfPieces = loadPieces(PERF_KEY, PERF_SLOTS, perfBlank);
  var creaPieces = loadPieces(CREA_KEY, CREA_SLOTS, creaBlank);

  function savePerf() { try{localStorage.setItem(PERF_KEY,JSON.stringify(perfPieces));}catch(e){} }
  function saveCrea() { try{localStorage.setItem(CREA_KEY,JSON.stringify(creaPieces));}catch(e){} }
  function saveNPerf() { try{localStorage.setItem(NPERF_KEY,String(nPerf));}catch(e){} }
  function saveNCrea() { try{localStorage.setItem(NCREA_KEY,String(nCrea));}catch(e){} }

  // ── Presenting Upload 1: programme notes word counts ──────────────────────────
  var PRES_U1_KEY = 'pres-upload1-words';
  var presU1 = {cw0:'',cw1:'',cw2:'',pw0:'',pw1:'',pw2:'',pw3:'',pw4:''};
  try { var _pu1 = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PRES_U1_KEY)); if (_pu1) { Object.keys(presU1).forEach(function(k){ if(_pu1[k]!==undefined) presU1[k]=_pu1[k]; }); } } catch(e) {}
  function savePresU1() { try{localStorage.setItem(PRES_U1_KEY,JSON.stringify(presU1));}catch(e){} }

  function renderPresUpload1() {
    var c = document.getElementById('pres-upload1-tracker');
    if (!c) return;
    var total = nCrea + nPerf;
    var rec = Math.round(600 / total);
    var h = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.4rem;">';
    h += '<thead><tr>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'">Piece</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'">Recommended</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:8em;">Word count</th>'
      +'</tr></thead><tbody>';
    // Creating group header
    h += '<tr style="background:#f5f3ef;">'
      +'<td colspan="3" style="padding:.25rem .3rem;font-size:.72rem;color:#999;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;">Creating</td>'
      +'</tr>';
    for (var ci=0; ci<nCrea; ci++) {
      var ckey = 'cw'+ci;
      h += '<tr>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'padding-left:.8rem;"><button onclick="presJumpCrea('+ci+')" style="'+JUMP_BTN+'font-size:.82rem;" title="Jump to piece in tracker">'+presCreaPieceText(ci)+'</button></td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.75rem;color:#aaa;">~'+rec+'</td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" data-presu1key="'+ckey+'" value="'+esc(String(presU1[ckey]||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
        +'</tr>';
    }
    // Performing group header
    h += '<tr style="background:#f5f3ef;">'
      +'<td colspan="3" style="padding:.25rem .3rem;font-size:.72rem;color:#999;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;">Performing</td>'
      +'</tr>';
    for (var pi=0; pi<nPerf; pi++) {
      var pkey = 'pw'+pi;
      h += '<tr>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'padding-left:.8rem;"><button onclick="presJumpPerf('+pi+')" style="'+JUMP_BTN+'font-size:.82rem;" title="Jump to piece in tracker">'+presPerfPieceText(pi)+'</button></td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.75rem;color:#aaa;">~'+rec+'</td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" data-presu1key="'+pkey+'" value="'+esc(String(presU1[pkey]||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
        +'</tr>';
    }
    h += '</tbody></table>';
    var totalWords = 0;
    for (var cj=0; cj<CREA_SLOTS; cj++) { totalWords += parseInt(presU1['cw'+cj])||0; }
    for (var pj=0; pj<PERF_SLOTS; pj++) { totalWords += parseInt(presU1['pw'+pj])||0; }
    h += wordBar(totalWords, 600);
    c.innerHTML = h;
    c.querySelectorAll('input[data-presu1key]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() { presU1[el.dataset.presu1key] = el.value; savePresU1(); renderPresUpload1(); });
    });
  }

  // ── Presenting Upload 2: audio times ─────────────────────────────────────────
  var PRES_U2_KEY = 'pres-upload2-times';
  var presU2 = {cm0:'',cs0:'',cm1:'',cs1:'',cm2:'',cs2:'',pm0:'',ps0:'',pm1:'',ps1:'',pm2:'',ps2:'',pm3:'',ps3:'',pm4:'',ps4:''};
  try { var _pu2 = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PRES_U2_KEY)); if (_pu2) { Object.keys(presU2).forEach(function(k){ if(_pu2[k]!==undefined) presU2[k]=_pu2[k]; }); } } catch(e) {}
  function savePresU2() { try{localStorage.setItem(PRES_U2_KEY,JSON.stringify(presU2));}catch(e){} }

  function renderPresUpload2() {
    var c = document.getElementById('pres-upload2-tracker');
    if (!c) return;
    var h = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.4rem;">';
    h += '<thead><tr>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'">Piece</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Min</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Sec</th>'
      +'</tr></thead><tbody>';
    // Creating group
    h += '<tr style="background:#f5f3ef;">'
      +'<td colspan="3" style="padding:.25rem .3rem;font-size:.72rem;color:#999;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;">Creating <span style="font-weight:400;color:#bbb;">(max 6:00)</span></td>'
      +'</tr>';
    var creaSecs = 0;
    for (var ci=0; ci<nCrea; ci++) {
      var cmk='cm'+ci, csk='cs'+ci;
      creaSecs += (parseInt(presU2[cmk])||0)*60 + (parseInt(presU2[csk])||0);
      h += '<tr>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'padding-left:.8rem;"><button onclick="presJumpCrea('+ci+')" style="'+JUMP_BTN+'font-size:.82rem;" title="Jump to piece in tracker">'+presCreaPieceText(ci)+'</button></td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="99" data-presu2key="'+cmk+'" value="'+esc(String(presU2[cmk]||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="59" data-presu2key="'+csk+'" value="'+esc(String(presU2[csk]||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
        +'</tr>';
    }
    h += '</tbody></table>';
    h += timeBar(creaSecs, 6*60);
    // Performing group
    h += '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.4rem;">';
    h += '<thead><tr>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'">Piece</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Min</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Sec</th>'
      +'</tr></thead><tbody>';
    h += '<tr style="background:#f5f3ef;">'
      +'<td colspan="3" style="padding:.25rem .3rem;font-size:.72rem;color:#999;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;">Performing <span style="font-weight:400;color:#bbb;">(max 12:00)</span></td>'
      +'</tr>';
    var perfSecs = 0;
    for (var pi=0; pi<nPerf; pi++) {
      var pmk='pm'+pi, psk='ps'+pi;
      perfSecs += (parseInt(presU2[pmk])||0)*60 + (parseInt(presU2[psk])||0);
      h += '<tr>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'padding-left:.8rem;"><button onclick="presJumpPerf('+pi+')" style="'+JUMP_BTN+'font-size:.82rem;" title="Jump to piece in tracker">'+presPerfPieceText(pi)+'</button></td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="99" data-presu2key="'+pmk+'" value="'+esc(String(presU2[pmk]||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
        +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="59" data-presu2key="'+psk+'" value="'+esc(String(presU2[psk]||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
        +'</tr>';
    }
    h += '</tbody></table>';
    h += timeBar(perfSecs, 12*60);
    h += '<div style="margin-top:.2rem;"><strong style="font-size:.78rem;color:#666;">Grand total</strong></div>';
    h += timeBar(creaSecs + perfSecs, 20*60);
    c.innerHTML = h;
    c.querySelectorAll('input[data-presu2key]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() { presU2[el.dataset.presu2key] = el.value; savePresU2(); renderPresUpload2(); });
    });
  }

  // ── Presenting Upload 3: music technology video ───────────────────────────────
  var PRES_U3_KEY = 'pres-upload3-times';
  var presU3 = {min:'', sec:''};
  try { var _pu3 = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(PRES_U3_KEY)); if (_pu3) { presU3.min=_pu3.min||''; presU3.sec=_pu3.sec||''; } } catch(e) {}
  function savePresU3() { try{localStorage.setItem(PRES_U3_KEY,JSON.stringify(presU3));}catch(e){} }

  function renderPresUpload3() {
    var c = document.getElementById('pres-upload3-tracker');
    if (!c) return;
    var totalSecs = (parseInt(presU3.min)||0)*60 + (parseInt(presU3.sec)||0);
    var h = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.4rem;">';
    h += '<thead><tr>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'">Item</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Max</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Min</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'width:5em;">Sec</th>'
      +'<th style="'+TH2+'"></th>'
      +'</tr></thead><tbody>';
    h += '<tr>'
      +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.82rem;">Video presentation</td>'
      +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.75rem;color:#aaa;">12:00</td>'
      +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="99" data-presu3field="min" value="'+esc(String(presU3.min||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
      +'<td style="'+TD2+'"><input type="number" min="0" max="59" data-presu3field="sec" value="'+esc(String(presU3.sec||''))+'" placeholder="0" style="'+INP2+'" /></td>'
      +'<td style="'+TD2+'font-size:.75rem;">'+inlineOverWarning(totalSecs, 12*60)+'</td>'
      +'</tr>';
    h += '</tbody></table>';
    h += timeBar(totalSecs, 12*60);
    c.innerHTML = h;
    c.querySelectorAll('input[data-presu3field]').forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('change', function() { presU3[el.dataset.presu3field] = el.value; savePresU3(); renderPresUpload3(); });
    });
  }

  function buildSel(row, field, opts, val, store) {
    var h = '<select data-store="'+store+'" data-row="'+row+'" data-field="'+field+'" style="'+SEL+'">';
    opts.forEach(function(o){ h+='<option value="'+esc(o)+'"'+(val===o?' selected':'')+'>'+(o||'—')+'</option>'; });
    return h+'</select>';
  }

  function renderTracker(containerId, pieces, n, store) {
    var c = document.getElementById(containerId);
    if (!c) return;
    var h = '<table style="width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:.82rem;margin-bottom:.5rem;">';
    var isCrea = (store === 'crea');
    h += '<thead><tr>';
    (isCrea ? ['Piece','Method','Genre','AOI'] : ['Piece','Composer','Genre','AOI'])
      .forEach(function(lbl){ h+='<th style="'+TH+'">'+lbl+'</th>'; });
    h += '</tr></thead><tbody>';
    for (var r=0; r<n; r++) {
      h += '<tr>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="text" data-store="'+store+'" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="name" value="'+esc(pieces[r].name||'')+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      if (isCrea) {
        h += '<td style="'+TD+'">'+buildSel(r,'method',CREA_METHOD_OPTS,(pieces[r].method||''),store)+'</td>';
      } else {
        h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="text" data-store="'+store+'" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="composer" value="'+esc(pieces[r].composer||'')+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      }
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'"><input type="text" data-store="'+store+'" data-row="'+r+'" data-field="genre" value="'+esc(pieces[r].genre||'')+'" style="'+INP+'" /></td>';
      h += '<td style="'+TD+'width:5em;">'+buildSel(r,'aoi',AOI_OPTS,pieces[r].aoi,store)+'</td>';
      h += '</tr>';
    }
    h += '</tbody></table>';
    c.innerHTML = h;
    c.querySelectorAll('input,select').forEach(function(el){
      el.addEventListener('change', function(){
        var row = +el.dataset.row, field = el.dataset.field;
        if (el.dataset.store === 'perf') { perfPieces[row][field] = el.value; savePerf(); }
        else                             { creaPieces[row][field] = el.value; saveCrea(); }
        runAutoChecks();
        renderPresUpload1(); renderPresUpload2();
      });
    });
  }

  function setCheck(substr, val, error) {
    document.querySelectorAll('li').forEach(function(li){
      if (li.textContent.indexOf(substr) > -1) {
        var cb = li.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]');
        if (!cb) return;
        cb.checked = !!val;
        var ind = li.querySelector('.auto-indicator');
        if (ind) {
          ind.classList.remove('auto-checked', 'auto-error');
          if (error) ind.classList.add('auto-error');
          else if (val) ind.classList.add('auto-checked');
        }
      }
    });
  }

  function initAutoIndicators() {
    // Find the auto-check items below the Creating section (after the last h3 before hr/h2)
    var headings = document.querySelectorAll('h3');
    var creaEl = null;
    headings.forEach(function(h) {
      if (/creating/i.test(h.textContent)) creaEl = h;
    });
    if (!creaEl) return;
    var el = creaEl.nextElementSibling;
    while (el && el.tagName !== 'H2' && el.tagName !== 'H3' && el.tagName !== 'HR') {
      el.querySelectorAll('li').forEach(function(li) {
        var cb = li.querySelector('input[type="checkbox"]');
        if (!cb) return;
        cb.classList.add('auto-check');
        cb.style.display = 'none';
        cb.disabled = true;
        var lbl = li.querySelector('label');
        if (lbl) lbl.style.pointerEvents = 'none';
        li.style.cursor = 'default';
        var ind = document.createElement('span');
        ind.className = 'auto-indicator';
        li.insertBefore(ind, li.firstChild);
      });
      el = el.nextElementSibling;
    }
  }

  function runAutoChecks() {
    var perfAOIs = perfPieces.slice(0,nPerf).map(function(p){ return p.aoi; }).filter(Boolean);
    var creaAOIs = creaPieces.slice(0,nCrea).map(function(p){ return p.aoi; }).filter(Boolean);
    var allAOIs  = new Set(perfAOIs.concat(creaAOIs));
    var fourOK   = allAOIs.has('1') && allAOIs.has('2') && allAOIs.has('3') && allAOIs.has('4');
    setCheck('four areas of inquiry', fourOK);
  }

  function renderPerf() {
    renderTracker('pres-perf-tracker', perfPieces, nPerf, 'perf');
    var addBtn = document.getElementById('perf-add');
    var remBtn = document.getElementById('perf-remove');
    if (addBtn) { addBtn.disabled = nPerf >= PERF_MAX; addBtn.style.opacity = nPerf>=PERF_MAX?'.4':'1'; }
    if (remBtn) { remBtn.disabled = nPerf <= PERF_MIN; remBtn.style.opacity = nPerf<=PERF_MIN?'.4':'1'; }
  }

  function renderCrea() {
    renderTracker('pres-crea-tracker', creaPieces, nCrea, 'crea');
    var addBtn = document.getElementById('crea-add');
    var remBtn = document.getElementById('crea-remove');
    if (addBtn) { addBtn.disabled = nCrea >= CREA_MAX; addBtn.style.opacity = nCrea>=CREA_MAX?'.4':'1'; }
    if (remBtn) { remBtn.disabled = nCrea <= CREA_MIN; remBtn.style.opacity = nCrea<=CREA_MIN?'.4':'1'; }
  }

  var boxes;
  function saveCheckboxes() {
    try{localStorage.setItem(CB_KEY,JSON.stringify((boxes||[]).map(function(b){return b.checked;})));}catch(e){}
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
    renderPerf();
    renderCrea();
    initAutoIndicators();
    boxes = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('input[type="checkbox"]'))
      .filter(function(cb){ return !cb.classList.contains('auto-check'); });
    boxes.forEach(function(cb){ cb.removeAttribute('disabled'); cb.style.cursor='pointer'; });
    try {
      var sv = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(CB_KEY));
      if (Array.isArray(sv)) boxes.forEach(function(cb,i){ if(sv[i]!==undefined)cb.checked=!!sv[i]; });
    } catch(e) {}
    runAutoChecks();
    boxes.forEach(function(cb){ cb.addEventListener('change', saveCheckboxes); });

    renderPresUpload1();
    renderPresUpload2();
    renderPresUpload3();

    document.getElementById('perf-add') && document.getElementById('perf-add').addEventListener('click', function(){
      if (nPerf < PERF_MAX) { nPerf++; saveNPerf(); renderPerf(); runAutoChecks(); renderPresUpload1(); renderPresUpload2(); }
    });
    document.getElementById('perf-remove') && document.getElementById('perf-remove').addEventListener('click', function(){
      if (nPerf > PERF_MIN) { nPerf--; saveNPerf(); renderPerf(); runAutoChecks(); renderPresUpload1(); renderPresUpload2(); }
    });
    document.getElementById('crea-add') && document.getElementById('crea-add').addEventListener('click', function(){
      if (nCrea < CREA_MAX) { nCrea++; saveNCrea(); renderCrea(); runAutoChecks(); renderPresUpload1(); renderPresUpload2(); }
    });
    document.getElementById('crea-remove') && document.getElementById('crea-remove').addEventListener('click', function(){
      if (nCrea > CREA_MIN) { nCrea--; saveNCrea(); renderCrea(); runAutoChecks(); renderPresUpload1(); renderPresUpload2(); }
    });
  });

  window.resetPresentingChecklist = function() {
    if (boxes) { boxes.forEach(function(b){b.checked=false;}); saveCheckboxes(); }
  };
})();
</script>
<style>
.task-list input[type="checkbox"] { width: 1em; height: 1em; margin-right: 0.4em; }
.auto-indicator {
  display: inline-block;
  width: 1em; height: 1em;
  border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1.5px solid #bbb;
  background: #f0ede8;
  margin-right: .4em;
  vertical-align: middle;
  position: relative;
  top: -1px;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  flex-shrink: 0;
}
.auto-indicator.auto-checked { border-color: #2e7d32; background: #2e7d32; }
.auto-indicator.auto-checked::after,
.auto-indicator.auto-error::after {
  position: absolute;
  top: 50%; left: 50%;
  transform: translate(-50%,-50%);
  font-size: .6em; color: #fff;
}
.auto-indicator.auto-checked::after { content: '✓'; }
.auto-indicator.auto-error { border-color: #c0392b; background: #c0392b; }
.auto-indicator.auto-error::after  { content: '✗'; }
@keyframes piece-row-pulse {
  0%   { background-color: transparent; }
  15%  { background-color: #fff3a0; outline: 2px solid #c8940a; outline-offset: 1px; }
  75%  { background-color: #fff3a0; outline: 2px solid #c8940a; outline-offset: 1px; }
  100% { background-color: transparent; outline: none; }
}
.piece-row-highlight { animation: piece-row-pulse 2.5s ease-out forwards; }
</style>
<div style="margin-bottom:1.5rem;">
<button onclick="resetPresentingChecklist();" style="font-size:0.78rem;padding:0.25rem 0.7rem;border:1px solid #c8bfaf;border-radius:3px;background:transparent;color:#888;cursor:pointer;">Reset checklist</button>
</div>
```

## Creating

- [ ] Each piece has a clearly stated and **justified area of inquiry** ([PM B](../resources/rubrics.html#pm-b,rt-realize))
- [ ] Creating work is no longer than **6 minutes** of audio total
- [ ] Score or notation is included for each creating piece ([PM B](../resources/rubrics.html#pm-b,rt-realize))
- [ ] Statement explains which **creating conventions** were applied and where ([PM B](../resources/rubrics.html#pm-b,rt-realize))
- [ ] Statement explains how the research or source material informed the creative choices ([PM B](../resources/rubrics.html#pm-b,rt-realize))
- [ ] All **four areas of inquiry** are represented across all pieces

## Performing

<div id="pres-perf-tracker" style="margin-bottom:.5rem;overflow-x:auto;"></div>

- [ ] All pieces are from **local or global** contexts — not personal ([PM C](../resources/rubrics.html#pm-c,rt-shape))
- [ ] Each piece has a clearly stated and **justified area of inquiry** ([PM C](../resources/rubrics.html#pm-c,rt-shape))
- [ ] Total performance time does not exceed **12 minutes**
- [ ] Performance recording audio quality is sufficient for assessment ([PM D](../resources/rubrics.html#pm-d))
- [ ] Musical communication is consistent and expressive across all performed works ([PM D](../resources/rubrics.html#pm-d))

## Programme Notes

- [ ] Program notes are within **600 words**
- [ ] Program notes address the selection of works and justify each choice ([PM A](../resources/rubrics.html#pm-a,rt-explain))
- [ ] Each work is explicitly linked to its area of inquiry ([PM A](../resources/rubrics.html#pm-a,rt-explain))
- [ ] All **four areas of inquiry** are addressed in the program notes ([PM A](../resources/rubrics.html#pm-a,rt-explain))
- [ ] Musical terminology is used accurately ([PM A](../resources/rubrics.html#pm-a,rt-explain))
